### God Can Restore You After You Sin
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/god-can-restore-you-after-you-sin-daily-hope-with-rick-warren-october-11-2018.html
Passage: Jeremiah 15:19
Points:
- Sin damages our fellowship with God, but our fundamental relationship as His children remains secure.
- The Lord asks stumbling believers to simply turn back to Him for complete cleansing and renewal.
- God uses repentance to restore His people so they can continue to serve Him effectively, just as He restored Peter.
- Returning to Christ revives the lost joy of our salvation and reestablishes close intimacy with Him.
